options.gain: Only the checks whose result a merge relies on are forced through it; no test command has caused a mistake yet.
options.how: Only the merge tool's lane lint, review record and release check, and a foreground CI job, must run through the verdict wrapper (the tool that prints a pass or fail and keeps the full log); test commands stay open until a mistake names one.
options.label: Keep the pick (Recommended)
options.lose: The other route is not taken unless you choose b.

options.gain: The other route, if you prefer it.
options.how: Every test command (pytest, unittest, test file runs) must also run through the verdict wrapper now.
options.label: Overrule it
options.lose: The governed work is redone or waits for the change.

reply: Reversed 12:57 CST by the coordinator after the retrospective audit found it wrong: option b is taken, so tests go through the verdict wrapper. The lane is re-pointed.
